row: Mama's Cradle Animal Sanctuary - Carina Suarez

WE ARE A HOME FOR THE ABUSED, ABANDONED, AND NEGLECTED DOGS AND CATS. WE ARE ALSO A HOME FOR WORLD CLASS POMERANIANS THAT MADE A MARK IN THE PHILIPPINES. 

This page is dedicated to Mama's Cradle, our sanctuary by the lake, and our rescued dogs and cats we rescue, treat, medicate, rehabilitate, rehome and foster.
We are a small group who rescue severe and critical cases of animal abuse, cruelty and neglect.
I am also a dog show exhibitor of pomeranians, successful in producing local Philippine born poms winning Best in Shows, Hall of Famers, Grand Champions, Champions and Award of Merit poms.
